name: Town Hall
effect: Houses 2 Population/Units, central building, gives 1 Diplomacy.
upkeep: 1 designated resource as tax per year

name: Homes
effect: Houses 2 Population/Units so that Unrest doesn't go up due to homeless.

name: Manor
effect: Houses 1 Population and important PCs/NPCs, can be a town's central building, gives 1 Loyalty.

name: Stables
effect: Gives 1 Horse; 1-on-1d4 adds 1 Horse each year.

name: Tavern
effect: Generates 1 Wealth per year, gives 1 Intrigue.

name: Market
effect: Can exchange 1 of a resource for 1 Wealth each per month, or vice versa.

name: Trade Post
effect: Can exchange 1 of a resource for 1 Wealth and vice versa yearly per trade partner.
upkeep: 1 Horse or 1 Ship when forming a trade partner

name: Merchant Guild
effect: Generates 1 Wealth and Diplomacy yearly, allows one yearly bulk exchange of one resource.

name: Shrine
effect: Gives 1 Piety.

name: Temple
effect: Gives 1 Piety, can exchange 1 Wealth for 1 Piety per year, quells 1 Unrest per year.

name: School
effect: 1-on-1d4 generates 1 Loyalty, attempts once a year.

name: Library
effect: Request tomes, 1-on-1d4 generates 1 Diplomacy, attempts once a year.

name: University
effect: 1-on-1d4 generates 1 Diplomacy, 1 Loyalty, and 1 Piety, attempts once a year.

name: Smithy
effect: Can exchange 1 Iron to create 1 Weapon or 1 Tool monthly.

name: Gallows
effect: Includes pillories and cages, gives 1 Dread.

name: Spy Quarters
effect: Gives 1 Intrigue and 1 Dread; 1-on-1d6 gives 2 Intrigue and 1 Dread yearly.

name: Embassies
effect: Gives 1 Diplomacy, can exchange 1 Wealth for 1 Diplomacy each year per ally.

name: Messenger Post
effect: Allows fast communication to and from regions via road, even to unexplored settlements.

name: Roads
effect: Creates a stretch of road for travel, allows trade to adjoining region.
costNote: 1 Tool per 3 hexes, plus 1 Wood if building through difficult terrain

name: Bridge
effect: Allows road to span over a river, either made of wood or stone.
costNote: decrease by 1 at a suitable crossing

name: Ferry
effect: Allows boats to help large groups cross a river.

name: Shipyard
effect: Set up on water; allows 1 Wood and 1 Wealth to be used to build 1 Ship.

name: Harbor
effect: Set up on water, can exchange 1 Ship for 2 of a resource yearly; 1-on-1d4 gives 1 Ship.

name: Farm
effect: Generates 1 Food each year.

name: Mill
effect: Each farm generates +50% Food each year (non-stacking per settlement).

name: Artisan Shops
effect: 1-on-1d4 to generate 1 Wealth per year.

name: Hunting Grounds
effect: Set up near forest or mountain, generates 1 Food each year.

name: Logging Camp
effect: Set up near forest, generates 1 Wood each year.

name: Fishing Dock
effect: Set up on water, generates 1 Food each year.

name: Mine
effect: Set up on mountain, generates 1 Iron per year.

name: Silver/Gold Mine
effect: Set up on mountain, generates either 1 Wealth (silver) or 2 Wealth (gold) per year.

name: Quarry
effect: Set up near or on mountain, generates 1 Stone per year.

name: Herbalist Hut
effect: Set up near forest, generates 1 Medicine every year.

name: Apothecary
effect: Gives 1 Medicine, can exchange 1 Wealth for 1 Medicine yearly.

name: Ranch
effect: Will create 1 Horse per year.

name: Tower
effect: Generates 1 Militia that will defend a distance of 3 Tiles.

name: Barracks
effect: Houses and can create up to 3 Guard/Troops that will defend the settlement and realm.

name: Training Yard
effect: Allows for upgrading any military Unit using retrospective resources.

name: Prison
effect: Holds captured humanoids, heightened escape DCs added by assigned unit and walls.

name: Scout's Nest
effect: 1-on-1d6 to add 1 Intrigue yearly, reveals potential threats or sites in 4 Tiles.

name: Wooden Wall
effect: Defends hexes from minor raids and danger.

name: Stone Wall
effect: Better defense for hexes from larger dangers.

name: Fort
effect: Can station Units to defend a distance of 4 Tiles, functions like a Manor, gives 1 Loyalty.

name: Castle
effect: Can station Units to defend a distance of 4 Tiles, functions like a Manor, gives 1 Loyalty.
buildTime: 2 years (1 year if building on a Fort)

name: Adventurer's Guild
effect: Can hire Adventurer Units using 1 Wealth for effectiveness, up to 5.
